name: Pomezia (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of navy blue and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pomezia (a female head beneath wheat on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Pomezia, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Pomezia arms — female head beneath wheat on blue, crowned, within branches
